01 About Ispi Cakes

More than a cake.
It is part of the moment.

Ispi Cakes and Pastries is built around one simple idea: when people celebrate something important, the cake should feel just as special.

My name is Akindele Israel, better known as the Sabi Baker. I am a pastry chef, project manager, and the person behind Ispi Cakes and Pastries here in Lagos.

I started young. My first big order was for 50 people and I was shaking the entire time. They loved it. That feeling of creating something people remember has kept me in this kitchen ever since.

Today, every order is made with quality ingredients, close attention to detail, and genuine care for the person celebrating.

FAQ

Good cakes start with good questions.

Planning a birthday, wedding, graduation or special event? Here are the answers to the questions we hear most before an order is placed.

Still have a question?
Let's talk about your cake.
Tell us what you have in mind, your event date and your budget. We'll help you figure out the next step.
Chat on WhatsApp
We recommend at least 3 days in advance for standard cakes. For wedding cakes and large event orders, 2 to 4 weeks is ideal. This gives us the time to plan, source quality ingredients, and give your cake the full attention it deserves.
Yes. We deliver across all of Lagos. Delivery fees are calculated based on your location. We handle every delivery with care to ensure your cake arrives exactly the way it left our kitchen.
We accept all payment methods including bank transfer, cash on delivery, and mobile payments. A deposit is required to confirm your booking. We will discuss the payment structure when you place your order.
Absolutely. Every cake we make is custom. Send us your inspiration photos, your colour theme, and any specific details and we will bring your vision to life. The more detail you share the better we can match your expectation.
Yes we do. For wedding cake orders and large event bookings, we offer tasting sessions so you can experience the flavours before your final order. Send us a message to arrange this.
Simply send us a message on WhatsApp at 08107109470 or fill in the order form on this page. Tell us what you need, your event date, and your budget. We will respond promptly and get your order sorted from there.
